text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The new year. I had come to the shrine for Hatsumode to renew my vow to support Narita Taishin, but—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ahhhhh!!!
Taishin's Trainerrrrr!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Geh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She hates crowds, so running into her at a shrine
bustling with New Year's visitors was quite unexpected.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No, I really didn't wanna come either...
but somehow, these guys dragged me into it.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I mean, look!!
We're finally in the Senior Class, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"The girls debuting after us keep getting stronger and stronger!
But the three of us are gonna get stronger together, too!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Then I gotta fire it up right from the New Year!!
WOOOOAAAAAAAHHHHHHH!!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Well, Ticket is pretty much always fired up,
but... I generally agree with the sentiment."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Come, let us go, Taishin.
...I intend to pray for your good health as well, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Nosy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I watched warmly as the three of them chatted in a much more relaxed tone than before or after the Kikuka-sho.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Now then, we're done paying our respects—are you alright, Taishin?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I give up. I feel sick. No way. I'm going home.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehhh! Even though we went out together!!
Let's stay together just a little longer, pleeeeeease!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ugh, Traineeer……!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The spotlight was turned on me...! That said,
it looks truly painful for them to stay here any longer,
so to help us move along—"
choice_data_list: I'll treat you to something delicious.
Maybe we should just go for a run instead.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Whyyyyy this shop, of all places...!?
Is this your taste...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, everywhere else was packed,
and this was the only place where we could get in without waiting in line……!

text_block_list.name: Bear-Eared Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, bear~♪
Just let me know when you're ready to order, bear♪

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: U-Understood... bear...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Are those the rules here...?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha, what an interesting cafeee!!
Alright, decided-dd!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Excuse meee! One Bear-Bear Pancake Set,
please-kuma~!!

text_block_list.name: Bear-Eared Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay♪
And what would that one like to do, bear?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Uh, ah...
Hot lemon tea for me, then...

text_block_list.name: Bear-Eared Clerk
text_block_list.text: A bear?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: P-Please... bear.

text_block_list.name: Bear-Eared Clerk
text_block_list.text: Roger that, beary much~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I'm definitely gonna kick you later"...
I felt like her glare was saying just that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Are you for real?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Even through New Year's?
My, that is quite some dedication!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Well, but if you think about it,
maybe this is just true to who we are."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Alright, since we're already out,
let's run somewhere that'll give us a fresh change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH!
The! First! Sun! RIIIISE---!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No, if it's already risen that high,
it's not really a "first" sunrise anymore, is it...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Still, this place feels amazing!!
I had no idea a spot like this even existed!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It really is a stunning view.
Taishin, is this a place you visit often?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Well, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah!!! I can see the racetrack!!
Taishin, Hayahide, over here, over hereeee!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (...This is the first time it's ever been this noisy here.)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Aah!! That sounds awesome!!! Hey, hey, the arcade is totally fine, right, Taishin!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"No... I only play games to kill time,
and I don't usually go to arcades or anything, but..."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ministerrrrr...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...*Sigh*, I told you I got it.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Really!? Yeeeeeeaaah-hoo-!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...You really are far too soft, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Shut up!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH!!!
FULL! POWER! BARRAGEEEEE---!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Idiot, don't waste the shotgun on trash mobs!
A big one's coming right after this—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaah!?!? What do I do, what do I do?!
Did I get bitten?!
I don't wanna become a zombieeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Dammit... Basically, if I hit the head,
it's a one-shot, right?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wah?! A-Amazing, Taishin...
All headshots...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Glad to see you're having fun.
